plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: Overview of scholarship scheme progress and pending cases across districts

panels.title: Applications by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Pending Cases by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS pending FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Districts by Pending Cases
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS pending FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
